testing-inheritance-and-polymorphism.label: Testing Inheritance and Polymorphism
testing-inheritance-and-polymorphism.summary: Write regression tests for subclass contracts and mixed-object services without rebuilding the production classes.

try_testing_inheritance_and_polymorphism.title: Write a subclass contract test
try_testing_inheritance_and_polymorphism.prompt: `CatalogItem` and `Book` are already complete. In `tests/check_book.py`, use the existing `book` fixture to assert that it is an instance of `CatalogItem`, then assert that `book.label()` returns exactly `Book: Dune by Frank Herbert`. Leave both model files unchanged and keep the final `book inheritance tests passed` print.
try_testing_inheritance_and_polymorphism.hint: One assertion checks the inheritance relationship; the other checks the subclass's specialized public behavior.

help.concept: A useful subclass regression test checks the relationship and the public contract without inspecting implementation details.
help.hint_2: Assert the exact value returned by `book.label()`.

try_testing_inheritance_and_polymorphism.title: Write mixed-service regression tests
try_testing_inheritance_and_polymorphism.prompt: `Book`, `Game`, and `build_labels(items)` are already complete. In `tests/check_catalog_report.py`, use the provided `mixed_items` fixture to assert the normal Book/Game labels in order. Then use the provided `edge_items` fixture to assert `Game: Untitled on Switch` followed by `Book: Beloved by Toni Morrison`. Do not rewrite the models or service. Keep the final `polymorphic report tests passed` print.
try_testing_inheritance_and_polymorphism.hint: Call the service on each provided mixed fixture and compare the returned list with the exact expected labels.

help.concept: A polymorphic service test passes representative mixed objects through the service and checks observable results.
help.hint_2: The second assertion retrieves the empty-title edge case through `edge_items`.

try_testing_inheritance_and_polymorphism.starterCode:
import sys

from models.game import Game

    Book("Dune", "Frank Herbert"),
    Game("Portal 2", "PC"),
]

    Game("", "Switch"),
    Book("Beloved", "Toni Morrison"),
]

# Assert build_labels(edge_items) returns:
# Game: Untitled on Switch
# Book: Beloved by Toni Morrison

print("polymorphic report tests passed")

policy_single_choice_1.title: Choose a useful subclass regression test
policy_single_choice_1.prompt: Which assertion best checks the specialized public contract of `Book.label()`?
policy_single_choice_1.hint: Test the result callers depend on.

help.concept: A regression test should assert observable subclass behavior, not reimplement or inspect the method body.
help.hint_2: Compare its return value with the promised result.

policy_multi_choice_1.title: Choose strong polymorphic-service fixtures
policy_multi_choice_1.prompt: Which TWO tests add meaningful coverage for a service that calls `label()` on a mixed collection?
policy_multi_choice_1.hint: Choose tests that exercise actual mixed objects and observable results.

help.concept: Useful polymorphic tests vary the concrete objects or relevant edge cases while checking the shared service result.
help.hint_1: A normal mixed Book/Game list is useful.
help.hint_2: An edge-case object inside a mixed list adds different coverage.

options.a: Assert the labels from a mixed Book/Game list in order.
options.b: Assert only that the service function's name is `build_labels`.
options.c: Assert a mixed list containing a Game with an empty title uses its documented fallback.

testing-inheritance-and-polymorphism-ske.title: Test the inherited relationship and the specialized result
testing-inheritance-and-polymorphism-ske.bodyMarkdown:
A subclass regression test can protect both the inheritance relationship and specialized public behavior.

```python
dog = Dog("Mochi")

assert isinstance(dog, Animal)
assert dog.sound() == "woof"
```

Those assertions answer different questions: is Dog part of the expected hierarchy, and does its override satisfy the promised result?

The test imports production classes; it does not rebuild them.

testing-inheritance-and-polymorphism-ske.title: Test polymorphism at the service boundary
testing-inheritance-and-polymorphism-ske.bodyMarkdown:
A polymorphic service is best tested with a mixed collection.

```python
notices = [
    EmailNotice("Welcome"),
    SmsNotice("Code ready"),
]

assert render_notices(notices) == [
    "EMAIL: Welcome",
    "SMS: Code ready",
]
```

The test passes representative concrete objects through the real service and checks the returned result.

It should not copy the service loop or branch on concrete types inside the test.
